bug_semantics: Bandit.WebSocket.Connection.handle_frame/3 in lib/bandit/websocket/connection.ex reassembled fragmented WebSocket messages by appending every Continuation{fin: false} payload onto a per-connection fragment_frame accumulator with no cumulative size cap. max_frame_size only bounded individual frames. An unauthenticated WebSocket peer could send a fin=0 text/binary start frame then stream unbounded continuation frames (never setting fin=1), growing BEAM heap linearly until OOM (CWE-770). Accumulation happened before WebSock.handle_in/2, so applications could not interpose a size check. Phoenix Channels/LiveView over Bandit are on this path.
flaw_origin: Unbounded fragment reassembly was first written in 8909391f486d42138c5308410bc5ea49a65f4d46 ('Implement continuation frames'). That commit added fragment_frame to connection state and concatenated Continuation payloads with data = connection.fragment_frame.data <> frame.data and no running byte-count check. Immediate parent 18c7030616bfecff3cd78a72362c600a3365ca63 handled only complete Text/Binary frames and had no fragment_frame or Continuation clauses. 6ab40a1ca44e7877b1c57d387727574d9c1e4957 later switched concatenation to iodata ([connection.fragment_frame.data | frame.data]) for performance but preserved the same unbounded accumulator. The cap was first added in 21612c7c7b1ce43eccd36d3af3a2299d23513667 via max_fragmented_message_size / oversize_message?/2.

reasoning: Vulnerability is unbounded WebSocket fragment reassembly: Continuation{fin: false} payloads are appended to fragment_frame with no cumulative cap, enabling unauthenticated memory-exhaustion DoS. The smallest commit that first wrote that mechanism is 8909391f486d42138c5308410bc5ea49a65f4d46, which introduced fragment_frame and the concatenate-and-continue path. Parent 18c70306 has neither field nor Continuation handling (introducer_parent_absent=true). The 2023 iodata refactor 6ab40a1 is not a BIC: it only changed <> to iolist accumulation of an already-unbounded buffer. Direct fix 21612c7c lands the missing cap and is contained in tag 1.11.0. BIC commit object is human (Mat Trudel) with no AI trailers or bot identity, so verdict is NOT_AI. Advisory remains published.
